close_reason: FederationTransport trait extracted. TailscaleTransport implemented. WhoIsProvider removed. All 1,197 tests pass.
description: kith's federation (Peer/deliver, Peer/receipt, Peer/typing, Peer/retract) is hardwired to Tailscale: discovery via MagicDNS peer probing, identity via WhoIs, transport auth via WireGuard. The JMAP Chat federation spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00) is transport-agnostic but kith only implements the Tailscale binding. Extract a transport trait so alternative bindings (DNS+mTLS, onion services, etc.) can be added without rewriting the protocol layer. This is prerequisite for any non-Tailscale federation.
title: Abstract federation transport layer
